title: Welcome to kSEE
question: See what the Linux kernel does for a program.
text: A real Linux runs in this tab. The program below asks it two things, each a syscall: `dup(1)` gives the console (fd 1) a second number, 3; `write(3, "hello\n", 6)` prints through it.
The kernel recorded everything it did for them. Follow [the write to the console](2:console_dev_write), then step with the arrow keys.
Now change the program: click a line, edit it, and press Enter. Try `write(3, "bye\n", 4)`.
